head: 33911b252005dbb3c0a0045d6cd077bb95da6f1c
method: Official Impeccable source detector plus audit.md. Read source, binding contracts and brief only; no browser, screenshots, prior reports or transcripts.

falsePositives.reason: Approved Geist + Hind Siliguri are binding under T1 and design guide; the font-import warning is not a verified POS monospace usage issue.

Legacy local cart sizes do not establish rendered size: index.css:784–809 overrides marked cart data/header/helper roles to 13/12/11 and proportional figures. No typography defect asserted from class strings alone.

scoreNotes.accessibility: Core keyboard/search, radio roving focus, named scroll region and shared dialog family are present. Hidden serial/shortage controls still have label, icon-name and validation gaps.
scoreNotes.performance: Product ranking is memoized and list bounded; no measured jank, bundle or runtime profile performed. Cart exit animates height and observer reconnects with line changes; no severe cost proven.
scoreNotes.responsive: Phone stacking, 768px single rows and internal cart scroll are implemented; multi-unit readability is scoped opt-in. Serial chip remove remains a 12px icon target without spacing compensation. No rendered reflow/touch verification by this isolated role.
scoreNotes.theming: Primary surfaces use existing tokens and shared portals; minor fixed rgba drag shadow remains at CartTable.tsx:76. No pixel contrast/dark-mode claim.
scoreNotes.integrity: Coherent existing POS family and protected calculators retained; several source gaps remain across preference-respecting copy and one native installment select.

problems.evidence: T7/T9/T12; audit accessibility. Serial removal is a bare X SVG (size-3) button without accessible name, 12px target with no enclosing label or alternate named remove control. Paste textarea at :98–99 has only a disconnected p and serial examples as placeholder; scan at :85 has placeholder-only identification. Error at :118 has no live announcement or association. StockShortageDialog.tsx:142–149 similarly disconnects vendor cost label and input; invalid state lacks aria-invalid/error association. These are source facts, independent of theme/viewport.
problems.fix: Use translated accessible names for each remove-serial control, ordinary shared target sizing or a valid spaced hit area, connected visible field labels, and associated announced validation. Preserve every serial eligibility/count and shortage/cost handler.

problems.evidence: Stable ID retained; T9 and design guide §24. Checkout calls AmountInWordsDisplay without language or label, so its default Bangla output and bilingual label remain in English preference. :120 still displays hardcoded 06 Oct 2026 · Counter 1. SerialPickerDialog.tsx:49–121 and StockShortageDialog.tsx:92–180 do not consult the language hook for operational options/errors/actions; Bangla preference still receives English. InstallmentAgreementPreview.tsx:66 prints stored row.status directly; InstallmentTermsPanel.tsx:79 uses English-only adjustment placeholders. Pos.tsx:769–779 shortcuts and :827–879 edit/draft/template banners are literal English.
problems.fix: Apply the existing language preference to POS-owned labels/helpers/status/errors/tooltips/accessibility text, pass explicit language and translated label to amount words, and source or honestly label the displayed checkout context/date without changing transaction dates, calculations or stored identifiers.

problems.evidence: T1/T12, design guide §10/transaction contract: the advanced adjustment uses a page-local native select with custom field classes, although the same POS uses approved FormSelect/AppSelect for fixed enumerations. Global radius/height rules do not supply themed popup and keyboard/portal parity. No rendered dark failure claimed.
problems.fix: Reuse the approved fixed-option select family with the same amount/percent values and onChange. Preserve adjustment callback, permitted values and calculation semantics.

problems.evidence: T7; audit motion sensitivity. SortableCartRow exit animates height to 0 for 0.16s unconditionally; no useReducedMotion or parent MotionConfig in its render chain. ProductCombobox and other shared controls already supply reduced-motion alternatives. Source verification only; no temporal playback inspected.
problems.fix: Respect the existing user reduced-motion preference for cart entry/exit/layout feedback while retaining immediate state visibility and reorder behavior; do not remove normal motion globally.

claimsIndependentlyChecked.sourceAssessment: Checkout completion copy can wrap and amount stays atomic at :371–378. CustomerPicker.tsx:53–66 now separates phone truncation from shrink-0 prior balance; full phone remains in DOM/title. Source supports intent; pixels and long-value fit need design/browser role.

CartTable.tsx:107–121 uses ResizeObserver and :160–162 makes overflow region named, focusable and focused-outline visible. Keyboard scrolling is now supported structurally; browser behavior not re-run.

CartTable.tsx:276 opts into readableValues; MultiUnitQuantityInput.tsx:42 reserves per-value ch width with default false; index.css:951–955 retains joined overflow scroll. No unit conversion/price handler changes in the reviewed diff. Actual fixture and several-product interaction proof belongs to browser review.

scripts/pos-browser-capture.cjs resets page/nested scroll before fullPage capture and asserts headerTop plus visible HisabIQ logo before/after screenshot. Pos.tsx and shell layout unchanged by current branch. Capture helper can enforce asserted header position; this role did not view output.

positiveFindings: Approved original React/shared-control family and tokens preserved.
Source diff leaves Pos.tsx and calculators untouched; unit numeric cleaning, quantity callbacks, shortage and serial handlers unchanged.
DraftsMenu and SaleTemplatesMenu delegate existing resume/delete/use callbacks, use language hook, and retain bounded list scroll.
Most installment editors already have translated labels, alerts, shared dialogs/tables/date pickers and honest preview disclaimers.
Product and customer IME guards are scoped; quantity Enter flow preserved.
limitations: Source audit only. No performance profiling, rendered contrast, text zoom, physical Android/touch, open-dialog focus or multiple-product interaction executed.
The fixed displayed 06 Oct date may mislead invoice context; correction must preserve source transaction semantics.
Legacy preview-only disclaimers remain source-accurate; no backend/stock/accounting change is requested or inferred.
